name: society-protocol-client
description: Society Protocol - A framework for creating Synchronized Network States. The future of human coordination.
author: Society Protocol Foundation

scripts.dev: yarn generate:persisted-graphql && GRAPHCLIENT_CODEGEN=1 graphclient build && next dev
scripts.build: yarn generate:persisted-graphql && GRAPHCLIENT_CODEGEN=1 graphclient build && next build --webpack
scripts.test:e2e: playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts --project api --project hermetic --project hermetic-serial --project hermetic-timetravel
scripts.test:e2e:smoke: playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts --project api --project hermetic --project hermetic-serial --project hermetic-timetravel --grep @smoke
scripts.test:e2e:unverified: E2E_INCLUDE_UNVERIFIED=1 playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts --project api --project hermetic --project hermetic-serial --project hermetic-timetravel --grep @unverified
scripts.test:e2e:install: npm ci --prefix e2e/aa-stack --ignore-scripts && playwright install chromium
